Home.subtitle: Automated census cleaning, real-time DHA & DOH actuarial re-rating, and instant quote binding designed exclusively for UAE Small & Medium Enterprises.

pillars.title: Closing the Gap Between Intent and Policy Issuance
pillars.subtitle: Transforming group health insurance from a multi-day email conversation into a compliant, accurately priced digital transaction in seconds.

census.title: 1. Census-to-Quote Automation
census.body: Ingest any employee roster (.xlsx, .csv, HRIS exports). Deterministic rules auto-remediate missing dates of birth from Emirates ID patterns, resolve relationships and map DHA/DOH salary bands in-process — with an optional Groq LLM layer for free-text instructions.

levers.title: 2. Live Re-Rating & Levers
levers.body: Move benefit levers—network tiers, co-pays, maternity riders, dental—and see instant cost impact per employee and annual group total without restarting underwriting loops.

lifecycle.title: 3. Living Quote Lifecycle & Diff
lifecycle.body: A quote is a stateful digital contract, not a static PDF. Version diffing, mid-term headcount drift detection and expiry alerts, plus an outbound Salesforce Opportunity payload that goes live the moment CRM credentials are configured.

steps.title: Four Clean Steps from Roster to Bound Policy
steps.censusDesc: Drop any spreadsheet format. Missing Emirates IDs, dates of birth and salary bands are auto-remediated and validated against DHA and DOH rules.
steps.leversDesc: Select the network tier, co-pay, pharmacy cap and riders. Pricing recalculates instantly across every life in the group.
steps.complianceDesc: The Compliance Guardian rewrites or blocks any configuration that breaches the DHA co-pay cap, mandatory maternity cover or the chronic-condition waiting period before it reaches underwriting.
steps.bindDesc: The authorized signatory confirms identity in the UAE PASS flow (simulated in this build) and snapshotting emits the Salesforce Opportunity payload for the same quote version.

Census.title: Upload & Auto-Clean Employee Census
Census.subtitle: Accepts raw Excel or CSV roster in any format. Missing dates of birth are recovered from Emirates ID patterns, salary bands are inferred from declared pay, and every change is validated against DHA/DOH rules. An optional Groq Llama 3.3 layer answers free-text questions when GROQ_API_KEY is set.

Governance.title: Data Residency, Privacy & Regulatory Controls
Governance.intro: These reflect what this deployment actually does with your data right now — not a policy promise. They update with the configured environment.

detail.piiProcessing: Census identities are priced in-process by the local rule engine; they are only written to {mode, select, supabase {the configured Supabase project} other {this server's memory}}.
detail.llmDisclosureOn: Free-text copilot answers are sent to {provider}. Names and Emirates IDs may be included. Unsetting the key reverts to the deterministic engine with no external call.
detail.llmDisclosureOff: No data is sent to any language model — the copilot runs entirely on the local deterministic rule engine.
detail.secretScope: The service-role key and database password are read only inside server modules (import 'server-only'); the browser bundle never receives them — the client authenticates with its own scoped access token.
detail.residencyPinned: All persistence targets a single configured project endpoint ({endpoint}); no data flows to any other store. Provision that project in a UAE/GCC region for regulated workloads.
detail.residencyNone: No external data store is configured — nothing leaves this process. Point the app at a UAE/GCC-region project to persist quotes.
detail.consentCaptured: Binding captures the authorized signatory's consent via the UAE PASS flow ({gateway} gateway), as required under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (personal data protection) and CBUAE consumer-disclosure rules.
